size_basis: L x W x H mm: body plus interchanger and compressor frame, in-house design X-MFG-30 (AQS-DUTY-060)
solids_note: one compound of closed solids: plinth, falling-film body (shell, bottom plate, tubesheet pair, 20-tube nickel bundle), vapour separator with mesh pad, blower and interchanger envelopes, relief-valve envelopes and the nozzle stubs; every union partner overlaps volumetrically, so the mesh reads back closed and manifold

a_hx.basis: A-HX: the falling-film area is reported drawn against booked; the node carries the 20.95 kW evap duty, so the booked area is the calculated figure (A = latent / (U 1500 x 6 K), AQS-DUTY-060 section 1) and the 20-tube bundle carries it at +1.1 % (the writer tube count is a ceil)

mvr.basis: node design (X-MFG-30, AQS-DUTY-060): blower ratio 1.616 at 1.189 kW shaft, recirculation at the minimum wetting rate, interchanger 3.67 kW / 0.146 m2 with outlets 50.6 C

holdup_L.basis: the recirculation sump is hardware at the minimum-wetting-rate book (AQS-DUTY-060); reported, no residence time claimed (A-VES rule)

relief.body: fire case, API 526 D orifice, set 100 kPa g (node relief_basis)
relief.shell: blocked outlet at 120 % blower flow, API 526 D orifice, set 350 kPa g
relief.drawn: two relief-valve envelopes on the body and shell (psv_body, psv_shell)
